clips.title: The story
paras: Innkeeper Gryshka sends a note of thanks to Zargh at the Crossroads after receiving fresh meat. The letter also introduces young Horde couriers to the wind rider flight network.

Innkeeper Gryshka thanks Zargh for the steaks he sends from the Barrens to Orgrimmar's central tavern. She recalls the time he lost a finger while preparing meat, then teases that he looks handsome even when bloodied by his trade.

To return Gryshka's Letter to the Crossroads, you report to Doras, the wind rider master atop Orgrimmar's plateau. Show him that you have already checked in with Devrak at the Crossroads, and Doras introduces young couriers to the wyvern flight paths linking settlements in Durotar and the Barrens.
